about: Text on the screen, seen in play on 2026-10-14 on an account of 奇匠 level 2 (level 1 shows no custom text at all). Seven client text boxes, each with what the save gives it: left/top at size 24, centre/middle in yellow at 36, right/bottom without outline, all three on a background that is 80% solid (the box gets rounded corners); a long line with autoSize, which shrinks to three lines inside its box, beside the same line without it, of which only the start fits and the rest is cut off; white letters with a red outline. The box live has no text in the save: the script writes control.text every second, turns it red at 3 (fontColor) and larger at 5 (fontSize). Two text windows hold twenty lines: win shows eight of them and a scroll bar; winbare stands its text right and has no bar (scrollbar: false). At the bottom a text box of the ordinary interface (scene_add_text_box, "金币：{1:ps.CT_coins}") follows a custom variable of the player that the graph counts up: it reads 35 at play second 7. The script reads back what the save gave: the window's text (1290 bytes), interactable true, showScrollBar true, the text and size of mid.
